rubric_hint.rule: 5 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Five eligible species (threatened, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded between 530 and 781 m from the polygon, and none within 250 m. They are Steccherinum robustius (EN, 530 m, 2016 record), Gyalecta ulmi (EN, 530 m, 2016), Gyalecta flotowii (VU, 530 m, 2016), Goodyera repens (VU, 711 m, 2025) and Boletopsis leucomelaena (VU, 781 m, 2025, 300 m uncertainty).

Within 250 m, no threatened species is eligible. The red-listed records there are mobile birds and a mammal, which are supporting evidence only (Glaucidium passerinum at 17 m, Prunella modularis, Astur gentilis and others).
Completed felling covers 0% of the polygon, so the site is not already felled.

Effort is adequate (988 records within 1000 m vs county median 75, 89th percentile). Within 250 m there are 88 records on 47 days, with none inside the polygon. The lack of eligible records near the site is therefore more informative than at a low-effort site, but it is still not proof of absence.

uncertainties: The three closest eligible records (530 m) are from 2016. The Boletopsis record has 300 m uncertainty.
Records beyond 250 m do not show that the species occupy the felling site.
Many near-site records are of birds, which are mobile and say little about the stand.
not_established: That the notified polygon holds or lacks eligible species.
Stand age or condition, because no tool describes it.
Whether the felling is legal or appropriate.
That absence of records inside the polygon means absence of species.
next_action: Have a reviewer check whether the habitat of the 530 to 781 m eligible records (fungi, lichens, Goodyera repens) continues into the polygon. Decide whether a targeted field check is warranted before felling begins.
